title: Business Central BC29: Control Global Symbol Versions

chapters.title: BC 29 Global Source Enforce Minor Version

features.name: Global Symbol Download
features.description: Feature introduced in BC 28 that allows AL developers to download symbols from a global source without relying on a Docker environment or Business Central client instance.
caveats: Symbols downloaded from global source are read-only versions without code
only major version is respected in version 28

features.name: Global Source Enforce Minor Version
features.description: New feature in BC 29 that constrains global symbol downloads to the major and minor version specified in app.json, while still getting the newest available patch within that minor version.
caveats: Must be enabled in settings or workspace configuration
Default behavior in BC 28 was disabled

features.name: Minor Version Boundary Control
features.description: Setting that allows projects to maintain minor version boundaries for symbol resolution while still benefiting from newer patches within the same minor version.
caveats: Requires understanding of major and minor version semantics

features.name: AL Extension Settings Configuration
features.description: Method to configure symbol download behavior through settings.json or user settings with al.enforce.minor.version parameter for version control.
caveats: Can be set at user, workspace, or user settings level
Workspace settings recommended for team environments
